db:select.doc:name: Ensure notification
db:select.db:sql: WITH ins AS ( INSERT INTO notifications (application_id, template, round) SELECT application_id, CAST(:template AS text), CAST(:round AS integer) FROM applications WHERE application_id = :applicationId ON CONFLICT (application_id, template, round) DO NOTHING RETURNING id ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ins) AS inserted, (SELECT count(*) FROM applications WHERE application_id = :applicationId) AS found

db:select.doc:name: Get notification
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, application_id, template, round, status, attempts, last_error FROM notifications WHERE application_id = :applicationId AND template = :template AND round = :round

validation:matches-regex.doc:name: Validate notificationId
validation:matches-regex.message: Notification id must be a number

db:select.doc:name: Update notification
db:select.db:sql: WITH u AS ( UPDATE notifications SET status = CAST(:status AS text), attempts = CASE WHEN CAST(:status AS text) = 'PENDING' THEN attempts ELSE attempts + 1 END, last_error = left(CAST(:lastError AS text), 300), sent_at = CASE WHEN CAST(:status AS text) = 'SENT' THEN now() ELSE sent_at END WHERE id = CAST(:notificationId AS bigint) RETURNING id, application_id, template, round, status, attempts, last_error ) SELECT id, application_id, template, round, status, attempts, last_error FROM u

db:select.doc:name: Get notifications
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, application_id, template, round, status, attempts, last_error, CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM created_at) AS bigint) AS created_epoch FROM notifications WHERE (CAST(:status AS text) IS NULL AND status <> 'SENT') OR status = CAST(:status AS text) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 200

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var nowSeconds = now() as Number {unit: "seconds"} --- payload map (n) -> { id: n.id, applicationId: n.application_id, template: n.template, round: n.round, status: n.status, attempts: n.attempts, lastError: n.last_error, ageSeconds: nowSeconds - n.created_epoch }
